description: §19.3.3 bare form (S441) + §14.4 E-TYPE-082 — `fail .Timeout("oops")` resolves `.Timeout` against the declared error enum `MyError`, where it is a VALID nullary variant; the payload arity is wrong, so E-TYPE-082 fires and E-ERROR-009 does not (the two never double-fire), exactly as for the qualified `fail MyError.Timeout("oops")`. Incidental W-DEAD-FUNCTION/W-PROGRAM-001 ignored by superset matching.
rationale: §19.3.3: the bare form's resolved variant is subject to the same construction checks as the qualified form; a valid variant with the wrong payload arity SHALL be E-TYPE-082.
